diagnosis: The logistics dispatch handler verifies Sanctum token abilities for route updates but fails to verify that the target RouteManifest belongs to the authenticated carrier's fleet. A third-party delivery contractor can hijack freight assignments and divert shipping manifests belonging to rival transport companies.

PATCH /api/dispatch/routes/8109/reassign HTTP/1.1
Host: logistics.freightdispatch.net
Authorization: Bearer 25|dispatchertoken1122
Content-Type: application/json
